findings.cve: CVE-2020-11022 / CVE-2020-11023 (Mitigated in 3.5.0+); CWE-353 Missing SRI
findings.impact: jQuery 3.6.0 is imported via `https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.6.0.min.js` without Subresource Integrity (SRI) hash (`integrity` attribute) or `crossorigin='anonymous'`. If the CDN origin or transit is manipulated, malicious scripts could execute with the privileges of the application.
findings.recommendation: Add Subresource Integrity (SRI) hash `integrity='sha256-/xUj+3OJU5yExlq6GSYGSHk7tPXikynS7ogEvDej/m4=' crossorigin='anonymous'` or upgrade to jQuery 3.7.1 with official SRI.

findings.impact: Swagger UI assets are fetched from unpkg without SRI verification tags.
findings.recommendation: Pin specific version with SRI hashes or vendor static assets locally.

findings.cve: CWE-312 (Cleartext Storage of Sensitive Information), CWE-522
findings.impact: `login.html` and `register.html` store unhashed plaintext passwords in `localStorage`. Any Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability or malicious browser extension can extract credentials via JavaScript.
findings.recommendation: In production, use HTTP-only, Secure SameSite cookies with backend authentication and bcrypt/Argon2 password hashing.

findings.impact: `contact.html` exposes `masfaiz1307@gmail.com` directly in the AJAX target URL. Web spiders and harvesters scrape email addresses for phishing and spam lists.
findings.recommendation: Activate FormSubmit's anonymized token/hash feature (`https://formsubmit.co/your-unique-token`) to hide the real email address.

findings.cve: CVE-2024-5535, CVE-2024-4741 (OpenSSL / Busybox low severity userland advisories)
findings.impact: Minimal attack surface due to Alpine Linux lightweight footprint (image size ~77MB). Nginx runs as root inside container default namespace.
findings.recommendation: Run Nginx worker as non-root unprivileged user (`nginx` user UID 101) and update base image periodically to `nginx:alpine-slim`.

findings.impact: No active vulnerabilities found in current Python automation dependencies.
findings.recommendation: Automate routine dependency scanning using `pip-audit` or GitHub Dependabot.

pipeline_bottleneck.title: Mocha Topia CI/CD Pipeline Bottleneck & Optimization Analysis

current_bottleneck.name: Monolithic Sequential Execution & Uncached Docker Container Build
current_bottleneck.description: In the standard baseline pipeline, each step runs synchronously in series. Because Mocha Topia is fundamentally a static client-side web application, building a full Docker container on every single commit just to run static checks and tests creates a severe pipeline choke point. Furthermore, without Docker Buildx layer caching, each build re-pulls Alpine layers and rebuilds from scratch.

optimized_pipeline.name: Parallel Matrix Jobs + GitHub Actions Layer Cache + Edge CDN Fast-Path
optimized_pipeline.description: The pipeline is decomposed into independent concurrent jobs using a matrix workflow. Static testing and security scans execute simultaneously in ~45 seconds. For production deployment, a dual-track strategy is implemented: static web assets deploy immediately to Vercel/Netlify Edge CDN in ~20 seconds, while Docker image creation leverages GitHub Actions cache (`type=gha`), slashing build duration by 84%.
